mapper.select: D.BIZ_YR, /*사업시작일자*/ A.RESRCE_NO, /*자원번호*/ B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM, /*자원번호*/ C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO, /*서비스실행사업번호*/ C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM, /*서비스실행사업명*/ B.RSFR_INST_NO AS INST_NO, /*기관번호*/ (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO) AS INST_NM /*기관명*/ , A.RPT_SE_CD, /*보고구분코드*/ A.TASKWK_RPT_SN, /*업무보고일련번호*/ A.PRD_BGNG_YMD, /*기간시작일자*/ A.PRD_END_YMD, /*기간종료일자*/ (SELECT DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 /* 종사자 */ WHERE ENFSN_NO = (SELECT ENFSN_NO FROM SAA200 /* 사용자 */ WHERE USER_ID = A.FRST_RGTR_ID) /*최초등록자아이디*/ ) AS FRST_RGTR_NM, A.FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일시*/ FROM AFA210 A /*업무보고 테이블*/ INNER JOIN SDA100 B /*자원기본 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO INNER JOIN SDA420 AS C ON /*서비스실행사업 테이블*/ B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO INNER JOIN SDA400 AS D /*서비스사업 테이블*/ ON C.SRVC_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_BIZ_NO WHERE 1=1 AND D.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' AND A.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%' AND B.RSFR_INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND (A.PRD_BGNG_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD} OR A.PRD_END_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD}) AND A.RPT_SE_CD = '01' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT A.RESRCE_NO, /*자원번호*/ B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO, /*서비스실행사업번호*/ B.RSFR_INST_NO AS INST_NO, /*기관번호*/ C.INST_NM, /*기관명*/ C.INST_NO, /*기관명*/ A.RPT_SE_CD, /*보고구분코드*/ A.TASKWK_RPT_SN, /*업무보고일련번호*/ A.PRD_BGNG_YMD, /*기간시작일자*/ A.PRD_END_YMD, /*기간종료일자*/ A.KLANG_EDU_ACCMLT_HR, /*한국어교육누적시간*/ A.ETC_EDU_ACCMLT_HR, /*외국어교육누적시간*/ A.RPT_CN, /*보고내용*/ A.ATFINO /*첨부파일번호*/ FROM AFA210 AS A /*업무보고 테이블*/ INNER JOIN SDA100 AS B /*자원기본 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ INNER JOIN SAA000 AS C ON /*통합기관 테이블*/ B.RSFR_INST_NO = C.INST_NO /*기관번호*/ WHERE 1=1 AND A.TASKWK_RPT_SN = #{TASKWK_RPT_SN} /*업무보고일련번호*/ AND A.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} /*자원번호*/ AND A.RPT_SE_CD = #{RPT_SE_CD} /*보고구분코드*/ AND C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} /*단위업무구분코드*/ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/

SELECT LANG_SE , NVL(SUM(PLAN_HR),0) AS PLAN_HR , NVL(SUM(LCTRE_HR),0) AS PRGRS_HR FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD IN ('04','05') THEN '한국어' WHEN EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD IN ('06','07') THEN '비한국어' END AS LANG_SE /*한국어/비한국어 구분*/ , A.PROGRM_SUM_HR AS PLAN_HR /*계획시간*/ , SUM(D.LCTRE_HR) AS LCTRE_HR /*교육시간*/ FROM SDA300 A /*자원 프로그램 테이블*/ INNER JOIN SDA100 B /*자원기본 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SDA340 C ON C.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO AND A.PROGRM_NO = C.PROGRM_NO AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN SDA320 D /*자원프로그램실행시간 테이블*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = D.RESRCE_NO AND A.PROGRM_NO = D.PROGRM_NO AND C.LCTRE_SN = D.LCTRE_SN AND D.LCTRE_YMD BETWEEN B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD AND #{PRD_END_YMD} /*제공시작일자*/ WHERE 1=1 AND A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD IN ('04','05','06','07') /*한국어 교육*/ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} /*자원번호*/ AND B.RSFR_INST_NO = #{INST_NO} /*기관번호*/ AND B.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' /*승인상태구분코드*/ AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' /*사용여부*/ AND (#{PRD_BGNG_YMD} BETWEEN B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD AND B.PVSN_END_YMD /*제공시작일자*/ OR #{PRD_END_YMD} BETWEEN B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD AND B.PVSN_END_YMD) /*제공종료일자*/ GROUP BY A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD, A.PROGRM_SUM_HR ) GROUP BY LANG_SE ORDER BY LANG_SE DESC

SELECT (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRMN_CS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.TRMN_CS_SE_CD) AS PRTPNT_LINK_PRECON_SE_NM , COUNT(A.TRMN_CS_SE_CD) AS COUNT_LINK_PRECON FROM SEB100 C INNER JOIN ( SELECT B.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY B.CASE_MNG_NO, B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY B.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RNUM FROM SEC100 A LEFT JOIN SEC100 B ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND B.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' WHERE A.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' ) A ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = C.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = C.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.RNUM = 1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT SRVC_PVSN_NO, CASE_MNG_NO, CASE_MNG_ODRNO, RESRCE_NO FROM SEB530 WHERE 1=1
AND SEB530.PTCPTN_YMD BETWEEN #{PRD_BGNG_YMD} AND #{PRD_END_YMD} AND SEB530.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO}
GROUP BY SRVC_PVSN_NO, CASE_MNG_NO, CASE_MNG_ODRNO, RESRCE_NO ) B ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO
GROUP BY A.TRMN_CS_SE_CD ORDER BY PRTPNT_LINK_PRECON_SE_NM ASC

INSERT INTO AFA210( RESRCE_NO, RPT_SE_CD, TASKWK_RPT_SN, PRD_BGNG_YMD, PRD_END_YMD, RPT_CN, KLANG_EDU_ACCMLT_HR, ETC_EDU_ACCMLT_HR, ATFINO, APLY_YMD, APLY_PIC_NO, APRV_STTS_SE_CD, FRST_RGTR_ID, LAST_MDFR_ID )VALUES( #{RESRCE_NO}, #{RPT_SE_CD}, #{TASKWK_RPT_SN}, #{PRD_BGNG_YMD}, #{PRD_END_YMD}, #{RPT_CN}, #{KLANG_EDU_ACCMLT_HR}, #{ETC_EDU_ACCMLT_HR}, #{ATFINO}, #{APLY_YMD}, #{APLY_PIC_NO}, '0', #{FRST_RGTR_ID}, #{LAST_MDFR_ID} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE AFA210 SET
PRD_BGNG_YMD = #{PRD_BGNG_YMD}, PRD_END_YMD = #{PRD_END_YMD}, RPT_CN = #{RPT_CN}, KLANG_EDU_ACCMLT_HR = #{KLANG_EDU_ACCMLT_HR}, ETC_EDU_ACCMLT_HR = #{ETC_EDU_ACCMLT_HR}, ATFINO = #{ATFINO}, LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID}, LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO__origin} AND RPT_SE_CD = #{RPT_SE_CD__origin} AND TASKWK_RPT_SN = #{TASKWK_RPT_SN__origin} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
